DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_DIMENSIONAL_P: At combat start, add a [gold]Potion Satchel[/gold] to your Hand and gain 1 of each basic Principle. At the start of each turn, gain 1 of each basic Principle. Draw 2 additional cards on turn 1, then 1 additional card each turn.
It stores no bottles, only possibilities not yet chosen.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_FIRST_FORMULA: In each combat, the first Formula that successfully brews a Potion costs 1 less of its main Principle.
It does not choose a Formula for you. It only makes the first step less likely to lose its balance.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_POTION_SATCHE: One space kept for a use that has not arrived yet.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_ORIGINAL_BREW: The first time each turn you successfully brew an original Potion, draw 1 card.
A record is most useful while the reaction is still warm.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_QUALITY_UPGRA: The first time each turn you upgrade an existing Potion in the Satchel, gain 1 of its main Principle.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_ORIGINAL_POTI: The first original Potion you use each turn returns 1 main Principle when targeting yourself, or 2 when targeting another creature.
A remedy changes with the hand that receives it.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_CATALYSIS_REF: The first time each turn you spend Catalysis and complete that card, gain 1 Catalysis.
The vessel remembers what accelerated it.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_DIFFUSION_REF: The first time each turn an original Potion affects at least 2 targets through Diffusion, gain 1 Diffusion.
The farther a ripple travels, the clearer its origin becomes.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_ORIGINAL_POTI: The first original Potion you use each turn grants 1 Echo.
Its last note is never quite the last.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_POTION_RESERV: Gain 2 Potion slots. Potion purchases cost 25% of their original price. At the start of combat, if you are at full HP, attempt to obtain 1 random Potion from the shared pool. Increase Potion Satchel capacity by 1.
A reserve is only useful when it stays within reach.
